relationships.note: Canopy's shipped signed-profile discovery flow offers a working reference for ArtFi's public onboarding. It does not automatically update ArtFi's on-chain registry or solve registry-event indexing.
relationships.nextTest: Compare deployed registry functions and authorization with the signed-profile model. Prototype a public-origin onboarding/index refresh using fixtures before requesting real signatures.

relationships.note: ArtFi offers a second, different registry/settlement source to test Canopy's evidence contract against, preventing a Busking-only schema. Source functions are not proof of matching deployed bytecode.
relationships.nextTest: Verify deployments and readable events under #20, then normalize synthetic ArtFi and Busking records through the same interface. Preserve eligibility records separately from actual reward transfers.

relationships.note: Busking's payment evidence/indexing patterns could inform ArtFi's transfer-linked reward records and duplicate/failure tests. Indexing is only part of this need; it does not itself transfer funds or establish eligibility.
relationships.nextTest: Compare work-reference idempotency, receipt matching and failure states with ArtFi's manual pilot. Require a separately approved funding and eligibility policy before any payout automation.

relationships.note: GreenTeaHut's project-specific reservation/refund state machine is a concrete comparison for performance escrow. Storefront escrow is not performer approval/claim behavior and cannot simply replace Busking's router.
relationships.nextTest: Write a state-transition comparison covering funding, reservation, cancellation, review, claim and refund. Resolve role and contract differences before proposing any contract change or deployment.

relationships.note: Existing canvas movement/collision modules may provide a small gameplay reference for the proposed radio game. They do not implement 100 levels, NFT rewards, 3D scenes or radio combat.
relationships.nextTest: Run an isolated licensed-code assessment and deterministic collision/input tests; compare one playable scene with #243 before choosing reuse, adaptation or rejection. Keep wallets and rewards out of the experiment.

relationships.note: The same game modules could be evaluated against Smarthome's documented Asteroid Belt intent. This is a candidate, not an established historical integration.
relationships.nextTest: Confirm the intended front-end runtime and prototype a single read-only scene without AI keys, wallet actions, or deployment. Compare build and rendering assumptions before sharing code.

relationships.note: A historical payout/event-timeline demo could become a bounded contributor lesson rather than another production payment system. The course currently contains introductory Python examples, so prerequisites need agreement.
relationships.nextTest: Design one offline lesson with simulated events and explicit learning goals; verify it suits the course level and contains no wallet transactions, real reward promises or unsupported deployment instructions.

relationships.note: Connect an existing supported source endpoint to Canopy's radio consumer rather than creating another upload or streaming service.
relationships.nextTest: Test known-catalog media routing, HTTP ranges, gateway failures and the next-track transition in normal browsers. Do not claim this resolves the separate decoder investigation.

relationships.note: Adapt Busking's upload authorization mechanics to BigNuten's provider-neutral backup path, without adopting public music visibility for health records.
relationships.nextTest: Reproduce the stalled backup using synthetic data, define confidentiality/provider boundaries, then test wallet, origin, purpose, expiry and replay rejection in BigNuten.

relationships.note: Compare recoverable worker checkpoints with BigNuten's existing personal snapshot lifecycle; strengthen the existing schema rather than introducing a competing one.
relationships.nextTest: Round-trip every supported record with synthetic snapshots; inject failed uploads, malformed snapshots and restarts, proving the last known-good recovery point survives.

relationships.note: Use Busking as the first real public fund/evidence provider for Canopy's generic adapter contract. Indexer claims and independent verification must remain distinct.
relationships.nextTest: Normalize a real payout and a second generic provider fixture; cover stale, partial, unavailable and unmatched states without treating missing history as zero.
